lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, featuring approximately four visible vertical columns with increasing spatial separation toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a matrix of grid-like anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient showing high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and defined shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of small, high-luminance spots, which are significantly smaller and more closely packed than those on the primary flank.
